name: Chromatic Flare (Costs 3 Actions)
description: The aspect flares with elemental energy. Each creature of the aspect's choice in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on her must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 39 (6d12) damage of a type chosen by the aspect: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.
